text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Yeah, don't worry about a thing. I'll run.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Tomorrow night. I'll make them 
regret ever laying a finger on my crew.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...Um, Pocket-senpai. I'm sorry, but I 
couldn't help overhearing.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
You plan to go out tonight, I see. Will 
you be able to return before curfew?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Who knows. I'll just keep going until 
they're crushed.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
You must not. Going out at night is 
fraught with danger. To prevent incidents 
and accidents, please return before 
curfew.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Then let's do this. I will accompany them 
as a supervisor and ensure they return 
before curfew.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Haaah!? We're going up against guys who'd 
do whatever it takes to win, you know!? 
Forget it, stay away!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
All the more reason if danger is involved. 
You will either take me with you, or you 
will run at a time that does not violate 
curfew.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Gaaah... Arrrgh! Fine, I get it! I'll tell 
'em to make it lunch instead, so stop 
butting in!
